reviewType: Narrow independent design re-review of six R1 findings and eight mandatory conditions; not product execution or implementation approval
summary: Five R1 findings and the non-policy mandatory conditions are design-resolved. One narrow R1-003 policy projection incompatibility remains with the actual unchanged collector loader: grant count/ID constraints and absent applicationPolicy must be preserved. No architecture restart, new runtime capability, or later-stage account/benchmark work is requested.

blockingGaps.classification: Design/source-contract mismatch; not a missing implementation test
blockingGaps.finding: C8 permits0..128 application read grants and requires a nonnull applicationPolicy object with a boolean flag. C12 allows rule-ID reuse across distinct selectors and normalizes absent collections. Actual observationOptions rejects more than32 readGrants, duplicate ReadGrant.policyRuleId anywhere in that grant list, and a present applicationPolicy whose allowStructuralDiscovery is false. Field-only configurations are valid by omitting applicationPolicy while preserving rules. The current R2 snapshot/projection is not explicit enough to preserve those modes without inventing a rejected false-flag object or widening the loader.

sourceEvidence.fact: Present applicationPolicy requires allowStructuralDiscovery; grants.length>32 and repeated grant.policyRuleId reject.
ObservationConfig.applicationPolicy is optional; ObservationRule field overrides are an independent array.
Exact field overrides precede optional application/region grants; highest-priority grant must be the unique candidate and allowed.
Frozen R2 representation/normalization does not state the actual32/unique-ID/absent-object constraints.

minimalCorrection: Represent TrustedPolicy.applicationPolicy as null OR the closed object {policyRuleId,allowStructuralDiscovery:true,readGrants:[0..32]}. Null means actual absence and projects by omitting ObservationConfig.applicationPolicy, never by creating {allowStructuralDiscovery:false}. A present false flag remains an invalid configuration under the unchanged loader.

Require ReadGrant.policyRuleId uniqueness within the complete readGrants list, independent of region/origin selector differences. Do not enforce a new global uniqueness rule across field overrides: optional FieldOverride records can share policyRuleId where the current source allows it; their testId stays unique.

Keep rules/FieldOverride independently available for field-only policies. Preserve existing accessibleName/classification/eligibility validation as well as structuralOnly denial. Empty absent grant arrays confer no permission.

Align C1/C8/C12 cap and normalization wording, keeping the already-proposed stricter field-override cap if desired. Do not edit/widen observationSanitizer or collector semantics to make the new snapshot fit.
focusedVerificationAfterCorrection: Check closed nullable policy shape and exact omission projection against actual observationOptions, including valid field-only rules.
Valid application/region grant with no per-control mapping remains supported;33 grants and duplicate grant IDs reject even with distinct selectors.
Repeated policyRuleId across otherwise valid field overrides preserves existing behavior; duplicate testId rejects.
A present false applicationPolicy is refused, and null/absence never becomes broad structural or read permission.
currentPolicyHash covers the exact effective absent/present representation and unchanged region/type/override semantics.
